strings.name: Brian Lara
strings.role: Retired cricketer and former West Indies captain
strings.summary: Brian Lara became a Caribbean cricket figure through left-handed rhythm, long innings and performances under pressure. He represented and repeatedly captained the West Indies. His 375 in 1994 and unbeaten 400 in 2004 successively broke the individual Test record; his unbeaten 501 for Warwickshire is a separate first-class record.
